name: Lingyuanopterus
sum: Istiodactylid from the Jiufotang Formation of western Liaoning, China.
holotype: IVPP V 17940 — Jiufotang Formation, Lingyuan, Liaoning.
material: Nearly complete skull, mandible and atlas-axis complex.
biology: Interlocking, laterally compressed teeth and shallow jaws suggest adaptation for scavenging (Xu et al. 2022).
author: Xu, Jiang & Wang 2022

images.caption: Holotype of Lingyuanopterus (IVPP V 17940) with a peipiaosteid fish above
Lingyuanopterus is a genus of Aptian dated pterosaurs known only from a skull and a cervical veritbrae
